note: PLACEHOLDER VALUES. Every threshold, rule and text below only shows the format. Since Phase 3b the model reads each heuristic's rule and proposes its change; the condition fields are unused. Replace them with values from the literature review before any study. Signals and counts never leave the device.

heuristics.rule: When buttons are hard to hit or taps land next to them, make the buttons bigger.

description.en: Bigger buttons are easier to hit. Make the buttons bigger?
description.da: Større knapper er nemmere at ramme. Skal knapperne gøres større?

heuristics.rule: When text is hard to read or the user tries to zoom in on messages, make the text bigger.

description.en: Bigger text is easier to read. Make the text bigger?
description.da: Større tekst er nemmere at læse. Skal teksten gøres større?
